faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services and process
faq.0.question: What services does Quartz offer?
faq.0.answer: We provide four core services: custom software development, business process automation, quality assurance and testing, and cybersecurity solutions. Each service can be engaged independently or as part of an integrated digital transformation strategy.
faq.1.question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.1.answer: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. A focused automation project might take 4-6 weeks, while a full custom application can range from 3-6 months. We provide detailed timelines during the discovery phase.
faq.2.question: Do you work with clients across the region?
faq.2.answer: Yes. We are a remote team serving clients across the Gulf and the wider region, with one dedicated lead per project.
faq.3.question: What is your development methodology?
faq.3.answer: We follow Agile methodology with two-week sprints, daily standups, and regular client demos. This ensures transparency, early feedback, and the flexibility to adapt to evolving requirements.
faq.4.question: How do you handle data security and confidentiality?
faq.4.answer: Security is built into everything we do. We sign NDAs before project kickoff, follow secure development practices (OWASP), encrypt data in transit and at rest, and can help you prepare for standards such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
faq.5.question: What happens after a project is delivered?
faq.5.answer: We offer ongoing maintenance and support plans. This includes bug fixes, performance monitoring, security updates, and feature enhancements. We believe in long-term partnerships, not one-off projects.
faq.6.question: How do I get started?
faq.6.answer: Reach out through our contact form or by email. We'll schedule a free discovery call to understand your needs and propose a tailored approach.

services.index.title: We build the software your business runs on, and automate the work around it.
services.index.intro: Quartz is a remote team serving businesses across the Gulf and the region. This page helps you find the right service for your problem, see what each one includes, and know how a project starts.
services.index.guide.title: Which service do you need?
services.index.guide.sub: Pick the sentence that sounds most like your week. We’ll point you to the service and the first step.
services.index.guide.label: Common problems
services.index.guide.0.problem: My team re-enters the same data between systems.
services.index.guide.0.why: Connecting the systems removes the copying and the errors that come with it.
services.index.guide.0.start: A 2-week automation audit that sizes the hours you’d save.
services.index.guide.1.problem: We run the business on spreadsheets and WhatsApp.
services.index.guide.1.why: You’ve outgrown general tools. A system built around your process gives everyone one source of truth.
services.index.guide.1.start: A 2-week product diagnostic with a scoped plan and a capped estimate.
services.index.guide.2.problem: Our website is slow, or weak in Arabic.
services.index.guide.2.why: A bilingual rebuild fixes speed and Arabic quality together, and lets your team edit content.
services.index.guide.2.start: A 1-week website review with a prioritised fix list.
services.index.guide.3.problem: We need an app for our customers or field staff.
services.index.guide.3.why: One cross-platform app covers iOS and Android, in Arabic and English.
services.index.guide.3.start: A 2-week clickable prototype, tested with real users.
services.index.guide.4.why: Automated regression tests catch what broke before your customers do.
services.index.guide.4.start: A 2-week QA assessment of your critical journeys.
services.index.guide.5.problem: A client asked us for a security test report.
services.index.guide.5.why: A scoped penetration test gives you a report you can share and a ranked fix list.
services.index.guide.5.start: A 2-week security snapshot of your main application.
services.index.disciplines.title: Four disciplines, one team.
services.index.disciplines.sub: Software development and automation are our lead services. Quality assurance and cybersecurity protect what we, or your own team, have built.
services.index.combine.title: One team builds, tests, secures and automates.
services.index.combine.sub: Many companies hire a developer, then a tester, then a security firm, and spend months translating between them. With one team, the people testing and securing your system already know how it was built.
services.index.combine.0: One brief, one contract, one point of contact.
services.index.combine.1: Testing and security start in week one, not after launch.
services.index.combine.2: Take one service or all four. Each also works on its own.
